name: massdo-skills
description: Skills for response style, raw text and code analysis: short ASD-STE100 answers, articulate replies, extract-signal, and implicit-state-machines.

interface.longDescription: Cap reply length under the ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English rules, applied to the user's language, write articulate replies under an optional word cap, extract the information in raw text while preserving meaning and uncertainty, and find the implicit state machines in code without changing it.
defaultPrompt: Use $massdo-skills:articulate 100 to write articulately under a word cap.
Use $massdo-skills:extract-signal to clarify this dictation transcript and act on it.
Use $massdo-skills:implicit-state-machines to find the implicit state machines in this code.
